proposalGuidance: Require exact caller/host-supplied current Run reference; never infer currentness from max sequence, mtime, directory order or Git history.
Use existing parse/read durable Run APIs for the exact selected occurrence and compose Policy facts only from that selected Run.
Keep history reporting non-authoritative and do not add a current-action/lineage registry in this Change.
Keep status/next/doctor as a thin CLI over existing Core; checkpoint evaluation remains authorization-only and Git execution external.
Do not add Delivery discovery, self-hosting, Skill execution, Archify materialization or OpenSpec mutation.
